verdict.rationale: The docs only mention migrating repositories from Gogs to Gitea as a recommended path, and a managed cloud environment is offered. One community user reports moving from self-hosted GitLab to Gitea, but another found migrating existing repos surprisingly difficult, and backup/restore weakness was cited as a blocker for migrating from Gogs. Missing for 10: documented importers for other platforms (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket), migration of users/orgs/permissions, a documented self-hosted-to-managed-cloud migration path, and hands-on corroboration that migration tooling works smoothly.
